basis: At the 2014 x-position, the blue circular mark (Industry) is visibly higher on the page than the red square mark (Agriculture). Although the chart has separate left (Agriculture) and right (Industry) axes without visible numeric tick labels, the visible vertical position of the blue mark above the red mark indicates that the 2014 Industry share is larger than the 2014 Agriculture share. Therefore, the follow-up record for the sector with the larger 2014 percentage is the Industry record.
